common.missing: This workshop does not exist (any more).
common.login: Your sign-in has expired, so changes cannot be saved. Sign in again; nothing you saved before is lost.
common.failed: That did not work ({{error}}). Please try again.
common.storageFull: The storage is used up. Deleting files or emptying the trash makes room.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.emptyBody: Create the first one and start planning.
workshops.trashHint: Deleted workshops stay here for {{days}} days, then they are deleted for good, with their files. Once restored, they are shared with nobody.
workshops.purgeConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” with all days, items and files for good? This cannot be undone.
workshops.unarchivedCount_one: {{count}} workshop taken out of the archive
workshops.unarchivedCount_other: {{count}} workshops taken out of the archive
workshops.deleteManyConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} workshop? It stays in the trash for {{days}} days. It is shared with nobody afterwards, not after a restore either.
workshops.deleteManyConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} workshops? They stay in the trash for {{days}} days. They are shared with nobody afterwards, not after a restore either.
workshops.purgeAllConfirm: Delete all {{count}} workshops in the trash with all their days, items and files for good? This cannot be undone.
workshops.noneYet: No workshop with a client yet. Enter the client in a workshop's details and it shows here.

planner.dragHelp: Space picks the entry up and puts it down, the arrow keys move it, Escape cancels. Enter opens the details, or folds and unfolds a group.
planner.dragCancelled: Moving cancelled, {{title}} stays where it was.
planner.parkingHint: Not part of the agenda. Drag items here to keep them for later, and back when you need them.
planner.deleteDayConfirm: Delete this day? Its items move to the parking lot.
planner.live: Live: changes from other windows appear here
planner.emptyDay: Add items or drag them here
planner.syncError: A change could not be saved. The workshop was reloaded from the server.
planner.keys: Click an item for details, its title, time or length to edit it there · drag to move · Shift+click to select several · Ctrl+Z undo · by keyboard: Enter opens the details, Space moves
planner.touchKeys: Tap an item for details, its time or length to change it there · press and hold to drag · the round button at the lower right adds in between
planner.moveOtherDays_one: Move the other day by the same number of days?
planner.moveOtherDays_other: Move the {{count}} other days by the same number of days?

item.title: Title
item.goalAdd: What should be reached by the end of it?

workshop.title: Title
workshop.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? It goes to the trash and is deleted for good after {{days}} days; until then you can restore it from the list of workshops. Sharing with guests ends at once.
workshop.duplicateHint: Copies days, groups, items, material and files. The packing list starts unticked.
workshop.brandingHint: Sets the slides and the logo on the printouts of this workshop. If the theme has no logo for paper, the printout logo from the settings is used.

packing.jump: Go to the item on the agenda
packing.empty: No material yet. Add material to the agenda items.

sheets.toLibraryHint: "{{title}}" is added to the chosen entry as a copy. The print rule stays with the workshop.
sheets.toLibraryNone: There is no unit in the library yet.
sheets.toLibrarySame: already holds a sheet of this title
sheets.title: Worksheets
sheets.sourceHint: Each page is a <section class="sheet"> (landscape: "sheet landscape"). Blocks and classes: docs/worksheets.md. Saving sanitises it; what the format does not know is dropped.
sheets.pickHint: The sheet is copied; later changes in the library leave the copy alone.
sheets.noneInLibrary: There are no worksheets in the library yet.
sheets.printHint: each sheet on its paper, as PDF through the print dialog
sheets.printNoJob: This print job no longer exists as it was – the print rules or the number of participants have changed. Open it again from the print package.
sheets.overflow: Content runs past the bottom margin and is cut there in print
sheets.printOverflow_one: One page runs past its bottom margin and is cut there.
sheets.printOverflow_other: {{count}} pages run past their bottom margin and are cut there.

sheetEditor.onPageHint: Click a text on the page to type in it · Ctrl+B bold, Ctrl+I italic · Enter or Esc ends · blanks (___) and new entries in the fields
sheetEditor.headerRaw: This page's header holds more than the fields know; it stays as it is (source in the ⋯ menu).
sheetEditor.title: Title
sheetEditor.over: runs {{mm}} mm past the bottom margin
sheetEditor.overPage_one: A block runs past the bottom margin: shorten it, make it lower or move it to a new page.
sheetEditor.overPage_other: {{count}} blocks run past the bottom margin: shorten them, make them lower or move them to a new page.
sheetEditor.heading: Heading
sheetEditor.tableRows: Rows (one per line, separate columns with |)
sheetEditor.tableHint: Empty rows to fill in: only the separators, e.g. " | ".
sheetEditor.question: Question
sheetEditor.label: Label
sheetEditor.caption: Caption
sheetEditor.rawHint: This block holds more than the fields know and stays as source. Changes apply when you leave the field.
sheetEditor.fill: fills the rest of the page

use.terms: term and explanation side by side
use.columns: a long list in two or three columns
use.table: a table, also to fill in
use.steps: the steps of an exercise, numbered
use.question: a question with lines or free space
use.rows: rows with a label and a field
use.circle: a circle with segments and an open middle
use.criteria: criteria with a value and notes
use.ticks: rows with a box to tick
use.pair: two columns with blocks of their own
use.facts: duration, method, material from the step
use.matrix: 2 × 2 with an axis up and one across
use.shape: pyramid, cycle, onion … empty to fill in
use.scale: scales 0–10 with words at the ends
use.selftest: statements with a box per answer and a sum
use.cards: cards with cut lines, two or three columns
use.certificate: a certificate or permission in a double frame
use.figure: a picture with fields to write around it
use.placemat: group sheet: a middle and four seats (best on A3)

sheetEditor.factsHint: The app fills in duration, method and material from the step the sheet is on.
sheetEditor.shapeEntries: Entries below the shape (one per line, may stay empty)
sheetEditor.stamp: Stamp or picture at the top right, tilted
sheetEditor.fieldsAround: Fields (the first above, the second beside the picture, more below)

printRule.label: Printing {{name}}
printRule.participants: Number of participants of the workshop

printPackage.title: Print package
printPackage.empty: Nothing to print. On a PDF or a worksheet in a step, choose how many copies to print.
printPackage.files: PDFs – in the ZIP, a file per job, with the print list
printPackage.sheetsHint: Opens the job in the print view. Choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog: the file name is the job already.
printPackage.needParticipants: Enter the number of participants first.

files.quota: “{{name}}” does not fit: the files of a workshop may take up 500 MB in all.
files.budget: “{{name}}” was not uploaded: guests can upload up to 250 MB a day.
files.storageFull: “{{name}}” does not fit: the storage is used up. Deleting files or emptying the trash makes room.
files.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? It is unlinked from all items.
files.wrongType: “{{name}}” cannot be attached: PDF, pictures, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Markdown are allowed.
files.deleteLibraryConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” from the library? Copies in workshops stay.
files.quotaEntry: “{{title}}” was not inserted: its files no longer fit the workshop (500 MB in all).
files.dropOrChoose: Drop files here or choose them
files.rules: PDF, pictures, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Markdown · up to 5 MB each

print.hint: Prints on A4. Turn off “Headers and footers” in the print dialog – title, date and page number are already on every page.

options.pageBreakDays: Each day on a new page

logoSource.owner: Logo from the settings (the branding “{{theme}}” has none for paper).
logoSource.none: No logo: neither the branding “{{theme}}” nor the settings have one.

settings.daysHint: Start and target end of new workshops and added days.
settings.categoriesHint: Kinds of steps with a quiet colour; set them per item, override the colour where needed.
settings.logoHint: Shown at the top of printouts whose workshop theme has no logo of its own. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB.
settings.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 2 MB.
settings.logoFailed: The logo could not be uploaded (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG).
settings.agentsHint: Agents such as Claude connect through OAuth and can then read and change your workshops: agendas, notes, material, packing lists and the library. Disconnecting one stops its access at once.
settings.agentsOff: Not switched on for this server.
settings.agentsConnectHint: A new connection can be approved only within 10 minutes after you start it here, and only once. A consent link someone else sends you at any other time is refused.
settings.agentsArmed: Until {{time}} you can approve one new connection. Add it now in Claude (Settings → Connectors) with this address, or reconnect it there:
settings.agentsDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? It loses access immediately and has to be approved again.
settings.agentsError: Could not load or change the connections ({{error}}). Try again; until then they stay as they were.
settings.themeHint: The branding of new workshops: slides and the logo on printouts. Each workshop can choose another in its details or its Slides tab. Theme folders under data/themes (theme.css, fonts, logos) appear in the choice too.
settings.sweepHint: Pictures no slide shows any more (in workshops, the library, the pool or templates) are deleted.
settings.slidesHint: Themes and templates are under “Slides” in the navigation.
settings.storageHint: Files, pictures and theme files together, those in the trash too.
settings.storageNearlyFull: The storage is nearly full; after that no new files fit. Deleting files or emptying the trash makes room.
settings.storageFailed: The storage could not be read just now.
settings.exportHint: Download everything as ZIP: the data (workshops, library, slide pool, themes, templates, settings) as JSON, the media separately.
settings.exportMediaHint: The media are files, slide pictures, theme files and logos. Their index media.json ties each file to the ids in the data.

toolbox.resize: Drag to resize · double-click to reset

library.subtitle: Items and groups to reuse in any workshop. Inserting one makes a copy.
library.emptyHint: Save an item (details) or a group (its ⋯ menu) to the library, then drag it into any workshop.
library.dragHint: Drag into the agenda, or + to park.
library.readOnly: Read only: insert entries in a workshop you may edit (sidebar, Library).
library.insertHint: Insert it in a workshop from the sidebar (Library).
library.emptyGuest: The library is empty so far.
library.trashHint: Deleted entries stay here for {{days}} days and are then deleted for good, with their files. Workshops keep their copies.
library.purgeConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” with its files for good? This cannot be undone.
library.purgeAllConfirm: Delete all {{count}} entries in the trash with their files for good? This cannot be undone.
library.bulkTagsHint: Click a tag: give it to all, take it from all, or leave it as it is.
library.missing: This entry does not exist (any more).

guest.nothingSharedBody: As soon as a workshop is shared with {{email}}, it appears here.

access.hint: Guests sign in with their own Microsoft account. They need a guest account in your Entra and must be let in at the Session Planner's login (see the guide).
access.libraryHint: The person reads the library and, with edit access, inserts from it into this workshop. They cannot change the library.
access.invalid: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
access.notListed: This address is not on the Session Planner's login list yet: the person can only sign in once it is added (apps-server README, section 7).

time.flowsHint: Starts at {{time}}, right after the item before.

notes.heading: Heading
notes.syntax: **bold** · *italic* · - list · 1. numbered · ## heading · - [ ] to-do · [link](https://…) · > quote · | a | b | over |---|---| table

output.pptxHint: text boxes, shapes and pictures to edit further
output.pdfHint: every slide as it looks here; text searchable
output.htmlHint: one file that runs in any browser
output.zipHint: all days, items, notes, files and slide pictures
output.presentFullHint: for the projector, in a new window
output.presenterHint: current and next slide, time and notes; also a remote on the phone
output.printPackageHint: a file per print job and the print list

slides.title: Slides
slides.tooMany: At most {{max}} slides per step: {{count}} were not added.
slides.missingPictures: Not found, taken over without the picture: {{names}}
slides.fromPool: From the pool or the library …
slides.existingEmpty: Neither the slide pool nor the library holds any slides.
slides.sourceHint: For small corrections. Only the slide format is allowed (docs/slides.md); anything else is removed when saving.
slides.poolSubtitle: Translated decks, uploaded once. Slides are copied from here into items and library entries; later changes to the pool leave the copies alone.
slides.poolEmpty: No decks in the pool yet
slides.poolEmptyHint: Upload a PowerPoint file, or the ZIP an AI made with the instructions.
slides.notesInEntries: Speaker notes come across only with these entries: without the tick they are lost.
slides.aiSkillHint: A .pptx becomes a draft in simple layouts here, with no AI involved. An AI of your choice makes better slides: download the instructions and give it the file and the instructions. Upload the ZIP it hands back here. Your slides go to that AI's provider.
slides.pptxWarnings: {{count}} places did not come across in full: {{list}}
slides.uploadHint: PowerPoint file, ZIP or folder: pictures are stored once, every slide is checked.
slides.createEntries: Create library entries from deck.json (existing titles are skipped)
slides.noDeck: The chosen folder holds no deck.json.
slides.deleteDeck: Delete “{{title}}” from the pool? Slides taken from it stay.
slides.themeUnavailable: The slide theme could not be loaded, so the file was not made (it would have had unstyled slides).
slides.deckEmpty: No slides in the agenda yet. Add slides to items (details) or take items with slides from the library.
slides.presenterHint: ← → to page · G all slides (arrows and Enter pick one) · Esc to leave · every window of the presentation pages along
slides.liveSync: Connected: presentation, presenter view and phone page together, changes show at once
slides.breakAsPlanned: As planned. Set the length or the end; the other follows.
slides.breakPending: The length counts from the moment the break slide is shown.
slides.breakNowHint: Put a break in as the next slide
slides.breakNowNote: Comes as the next slide and counts from the moment it shows. Only in this presentation; the agenda and printouts keep the plan.
slides.breakFailed: Not set: no connection to the server.
slides.breakHint: For this presentation only. The agenda, the agenda slides and the printouts keep the plan.

layoutUse.title: the first slide of a workshop or day
layoutUse.agenda: the plan of a day with times
layoutUse.break: a pause with its end time
layoutUse.statement: one sentence that carries the slide
layoutUse.list: bullet points, one or two levels
layoutUse.split: text beside a picture or diagram
layoutUse.figure: one large picture with a caption
layoutUse.steps: a sequence of three to five steps
layoutUse.number: one large figure with its evidence, or up to four side by side
layoutUse.compare: two columns against each other: before and after, A and B
layoutUse.timeline: three to six dated points on one line
layoutUse.diagram: a shape drawn from two to five entries: pyramid, ring, circles

slides.sampleHint: The words are samples: type over them.
slides.sampleLeft_one: This slide still shows a sample phrase:
slides.sampleLeft_other: This slide still shows {{count}} sample phrases, for example:
slides.sampleSlides_one: Slide {{list}} still shows sample text of a starter slide.
slides.sampleSlides_other: {{count}} slides still show sample text of a starter slide: {{list}}.
slides.templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Save a slide as a template in the editor, or create one under Settings.
slides.overflow: The content runs over the edge of the slide: shorten it or pick another layout.
slides.generatedHint: The app generates this kind of slide from the plan; write one only for a special case.

editor.lost_one: {{count}} entry does not fit this layout and was left out.
editor.lost_other: {{count}} entries do not fit this layout and were left out.
editor.lostFigure: The picture has no place in this layout.
editor.lostSvg: The diagram has no place in this layout.
editor.lostSource: The source line has no place in this layout.

shapeUse.pyramid: layers that build on each other
shapeUse.cycle: a cycle with an open middle
shapeUse.onion: a core and what surrounds it
shapeUse.hub: one thing and what belongs to it

miss.source: the source line has no place

editor.raw: This slide's structure is not in the catalogue; its content is edited as source.
editor.svgHint: Inline SVG with the theme classes (f-accent, s-line, t …), viewBox about 0 0 1152 470. Colours never as literal values.
editor.lostImages_one: {{count}} picture has no place in this layout.
editor.lostImages_other: {{count}} pictures have no place in this layout.
editor.lostOther: Other parts (note, quotation source) have no place in this layout.
editor.rawWhole: This slide has formatting the fields cannot show (emphasis inside a word, extras in the header, for instance). So that nothing is lost unnoticed, it is edited as source.
editor.layoutLocked: Slides edited as source keep their layout.
editor.changedElsewhere: This step was changed elsewhere meanwhile and is not taken back.
editor.addHere: This slide comes from the plan; new slides go into a step.

generated.title: The title slide comes from the workshop: title, date, client and location. Change them there and the slide follows.
generated.agenda: The agenda slide comes from the day's plan with the computed times and follows every change.
generated.break: The break slide comes from the break: title, length and end come from the plan. With a slide of your own for this break, yours is shown instead.
generated.group: The divider slide comes from the group: it stands before its first step and shows its title. Rename the group in the plan and the slide follows. Groups without a title get none.

editor.poolNote: Slides of the pool stay as they are. Take them into a step with “New slide” → “From the pool or the library”, or save them as a template.
editor.titlePerDay: Every day has its own title slide. Picture and variant apply to this one only.
editor.titleNoPicture: This theme shows no picture on the title slide.

onSlide.cannotRemove: This cannot be deleted on the slide. The fields can do it.
onSlide.cannotChange: This change does not fit the layout and was not saved. Please edit it in its field.

themes.paperHint: For worksheets: the ground is white, type and logo come from the theme, the accent only where it reads on white.
themes.paperDark: A dark theme prints light: white ground, dark text, the fonts kept. The logo comes from the printout settings, as the one uploaded here is made for the dark ground.
themes.paperFooterHint: Stands beside the date, e.g. a name or a web address.
themes.title: Slide themes
themes.subtitle: Colours, fonts and logo of the slides; the logo also heads the printouts. A theme is chosen per workshop as its branding; the layouts stay the same.
themes.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Workshops that use it fall back to the default theme.
themes.name: Name
themes.folderHint: This theme is a stylesheet on the server and is maintained there. Printouts show a file logo.svg, logo.png, logo.webp or logo.jpg beside its theme.css; without one, the printout logo from the settings.
themes.builtinHint: The app's neutral theme. Copy it to set your own colours.
themes.derivedHint: Surfaces, lines and the quieter text colours are derived from background and text. Override one here if needed.
themes.chrome: Footer line with deck name and slide number
themes.titleSlideHint: Where the picture of the title slide stands. Applies to all workshops with this theme; a workshop can choose differently for each of its title slides.
themes.titleOwnRules: This theme has rules of its own. Where they set the title slide themselves, the tiles show which variants they hold for: untick the others below.
themes.titleChoices: Can be chosen in a workshop
themes.titleChoicesHint: The theme's default can always be chosen.
themes.titlePictureHint: Stands on every title slide that has no picture of its own chosen in the workshop and shows this kind of picture. Otherwise the slide takes the pool's pictures in turn. On offer is the kind the theme's variant shows: photos for a column, a band or the background, illustrations where the picture stands whole.
themes.titlePictureEmpty: This theme's pool has no picture of the kind this variant shows yet: photos for a column, a band or the background, illustrations where the picture stands whole. Upload some below, then one can be set as the title picture.
themes.familyHint: Playful lays the school family over the same layouts: one disc per slide, numerals in discs, the wavy line under titles, flat figures whole on the disc. The accent leads, the second accent answers, the field colour is the dark pole.
themes.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB. The light logo is used on section and closing slides.
themes.contrastHint: WCAG 2.2: at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text (from 24 px).
themes.empty: No theme of your own yet.
themes.failed: The theme could not be saved.
themes.logoTooLarge: The logo is larger than 2 MB.
themes.logoFailed: The logo could not be uploaded (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG).
themes.poolHint: Photos, illustrations and icons. The generated title, agenda and break slides take a picture in turn, of the kind their place shows, in a fixed order per workshop; the editor offers the place's kind first. Tags, separated by commas, make them findable in the editor and for the assistant. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB.
themes.picturesHint: Are cropped: as a column, a band or the background on title, agenda, break and section slides, beside the text to the slide's edge.
themes.illustrationsHint: Stand whole and free beside the text: text beside an illustration, a picture with a caption, cards with whole pictures, worksheets.
themes.iconsHint: Small marks above the text of a card.
themes.poolFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
themes.dropHint: Drag pictures here or upload them, several at once.
themes.ownHint: CSS over everything the settings above generate – for a brand they do not cover. :scope stands for this theme ([data-theme="…"]); files are addressed relative to it: url(fonts/Brand.woff2).
themes.ownFilesHint: Fonts and pictures of the rules, up to 5 MB. Fonts go under fonts/, pictures under assets/.
themes.fileFailed: The file could not be uploaded (a font or picture, up to 5 MB).
themes.logoPrint: The logo also heads the printouts of the workshops in this theme (on white paper).
themes.logoPrintDark: Dark theme: its logo is made for the dark ground and is not used on printouts; they show the printout logo from the settings.

templates.title: Slide templates
templates.subtitle: Named slides to start from. Inserting one makes a copy; later changes to the template leave inserted slides alone.
templates.emptyHint: Create one from a layout, or save a slide as a template in the editor.
templates.name: Name

pictures.title: Picture pool
pictures.subtitle: Photos, illustrations and icons of a theme. The generated title, agenda and break slides take a picture in turn, of the kind their place shows; the editor offers the place's kind first. Tags, separated by commas, make them findable in the editor and for the assistant.
pictures.belongsTo: The pool belongs to the theme “{{name}}”.
pictures.noTheme: The picture pool belongs to a theme kept as data. Create one first:

offline.title: Offline on this device
offline.offHint: Nothing is kept on this device.
offline.failed: That did not work. Try again with a connection.
offline.hint: When the connection breaks or there is none, this device shows the workshops from ten days ago to thirty days ahead the last ten opened here, and those you keep here with “Keep on this device” in a workshop’s ⋯ menu: the agenda, the moderation plan, presenting with the presenter view. Read-only: changes wait for the connection. The copy stays in this browser until you turn this off. Switch it on only on your own device.
offline.hintSignOut: When the connection breaks or there is none, this device shows the workshops from ten days ago to thirty days ahead the last ten opened here, and those you keep here with “Keep on this device” in a workshop’s ⋯ menu: the agenda, the moderation plan, presenting with the presenter view. Read-only: changes wait for the connection. The copy stays in this browser until you turn this off or sign out. Switch it on only on your own device.
offline.bar: No connection to the server. This is the offline copy as of {{at}}; changes are possible again once the connection is back.
offline.notKept: No connection, and this workshop is not in the offline copy of this device.
offline.notOnDevice: “{{title}}” is not stored on this device; it opens again once connected.
